Understudy is a performer prepared to replace another, script the written dialogue and directions, and makeup the cosmetics creating an appearance. The audience is the group receiving the performance. An ovation is an enthusiastic audience response, often with sustained applause. It need not be a standing ovation or an encore. The review describes the audience’s response after the show rather than a further scheduled performance.
